name: jquery-to-react
description: Migrate jQuery apps and pages to React — full rewrites or incremental strangler-fig migrations of any size, including jQuery plugins and jQuery UI.

interface.longDescription: Migrate jQuery apps and pages to React — full rewrites or incremental strangler-fig migrations of any size, including jQuery plugins and jQuery UI. Keeps resumable migration state in .migration/, inventories the app before changing code, and checks each migrated piece for parity with the original.
defaultPrompt: Plan a migration of this jQuery app to React
